Detention Memo App

Detention Memo App
(Test Version)

1. Section Master
2. Add Section (Stations)
3. Train Master
4. Remark Mapping
5. Memo Generator

Section Master

Section ka naam do (jaise "GWL-GUNA Section"). Uske andar ke stations "Add Section (Stations)" page se add hote hain. Traffic/Engg Gain ab Train Master me train ke sath set hota hai.

Saved Sections
SectionStations Chain
Koi section add nahi hua abhi.

Add Section (Stations)

Pehle "Section Master" me ek section bana lo, fir yahan select karo.
Is Section ke Stations (chain)
FromTo
Abhi koi station entry nahi hai.

Train Master

Pehle Section Master me sections add karo.
Saved Trains
Train No.WTT DepWTT ArrTraffic GainEngg GainSections
Koi train add nahi hui abhi.

Remark → Category Mapping

CSV me jo Remark code likhoge (jaise LC, C/D, BP Test), uski category yahan set karo — Traffic / Engg / Misc. Naya remark aaye to yahan add kar dena.

Memo Generator

Ye prompt copy karke ChatGPT/Claude me apna raw memo message/photo ke saath paste karo — wo tumhe neeche wala CSV format bana ke dega, use yahan paste karke Generate dabao.
Upar wala header block (key:value, ek line ek field) — phir ek line me sirf --- — phir Loss,Section,Remark rows.
Section select karte hi uske andar ke stations niche detention entry ke liye aa jayenge.
